_comment: Template for data/afclaude.json (local, gitignored; or $AFCLAUDE_CONFIG). Copy it, fill in the values, delete what you don't need: every key is optional and falls back to the code default (afclaude_config.py). Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_settings_comment: This file holds only machine identity (D-146). Every tunable (window, budget, pacing, dispatcher timings) is a setting in the DB settings table (actions.SETTINGS: code defaults, set with actions.py / the dashboard; `python3 afclaude_config.py` lists them). Tunables still found here are imported into the DB once and removed from this file.
